boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase ways to pray, gather, walk, reflect, and explore on Franciscan’s campus and around Steubenville.

cards.title: Share a Quiet Hour at the Port
cards.subtitle: Eucharistic adoration in Franciscan’s small stone chapel
cards.notes: Meet inside for silent prayer, keep conversation outdoors, and check the Chapel Bulletin for school-break exceptions before going.
cards.short_summary: A hushed, visitor-friendly chapel for free daily prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan states that the Portiuncula welcomes students and visitors for prayer and adoration, with daily access and no admission or purchase identified.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; during the school year it opens 24/7 after perpetual adoration begins. Check the Chapel Bulletin for exceptions and breaks.

cards.title: Pause Beneath the Stained Glass
cards.subtitle: Prayer and reflection at the central campus chapel
cards.notes: Choose a quiet window between liturgies, sit near the sacrament-themed glass, and confirm the current chapel schedule before gathering.
cards.short_summary: An indoor meeting point where a group can pray or quietly take in the chapel art.
cards.evidence_claim: The official chapel page invites people to pray in Christ the King Chapel and identifies prayer, Mass, and confession as its uses without an admission requirement.
cards.source_title: Christ the King Chapel | Chapel Ministries
cards.access_notes: The cited page lists school-year access from 5:30 a.m. to midnight; check Chapel Ministries for current schedules and renovation-related changes.

cards.title: Bring a Rosary to the Grotto
cards.subtitle: Outdoor prayer beside the Portiuncula
cards.notes: Gather by the Our Lady of Lourdes statue for a quiet decade of the Rosary, then leave the shrine and nearby paths tidy.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor shrine suited to a short, no-cost prayer meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan identifies the Marian Grotto as a place where visitors and campus groups pray, sing, and reflect; these activities require no admission or purchase.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus shrine; the source provides no fixed hours. Use normal campus access and avoid disrupting organized prayer.

cards.title: Walk the Hillside Stations
cards.subtitle: A reflective route through 15 outdoor stations
cards.notes: Start at the wooden stairs behind the Portiuncula, wear shoes suitable for a dirt hillside, and move slowly through all 15 stations.
cards.short_summary: A contemplative outdoor walk pairing wooded terrain with bronze devotional art.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes an outdoor dirt path where pilgrims walk and meditate through 15 Stations of the Cross, with no admission or purchase required.
cards.source_title: The Stations of the Cross | Chapel Ministries
cards.access_notes: The route includes wooden stairs and a hillside dirt path. Visit in daylight and avoid wet, icy, or otherwise unsafe trail conditions.

cards.title: Sit for a Quiet Memorial Reflection
cards.subtitle: Prayer at the campus memorial near the Portiuncula
cards.notes: Use the surrounding benches for a brief reflective meetup, respect memorial items already present, and keep voices low near others praying.
cards.short_summary: A solemn outdoor memorial with seating for individual or small-group reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan calls the Tomb a place of prayer for students and visitors and documents its benches, patio, and kneelers; visiting requires no purchase.
cards.source_title: Tomb of the Unborn Child | Chapel Ministries
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial across from the Portiuncula. Be considerate of scheduled prayer, including student Rosaries during the school year.

cards.title: Study the Year-Round Crèche
cards.subtitle: A nearly life-size manger scene in stone
cards.notes: Meet by the enclosure and compare its crib, cross, yoke, bread, and water symbols using the university’s explanation as your guide.
cards.short_summary: A year-round outdoor artwork that rewards a careful, detail-by-detail look.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page identifies this as a year-round manger scene near the Portiuncula and explains its visible symbols; viewing needs no admission or purchase.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor display near the Portiuncula and Tomb of the Unborn Child; no fixed hours are published on the cited page.

cards.title: Catch Up in Kelly’s Garden
cards.subtitle: A two-bench campus garden near the Rosary Circle
cards.notes: Claim one of the two benches for a low-key conversation, read the memorial plaque, and leave room if others arrive to pray.
cards.short_summary: A compact memorial garden designed for conversation, friendship, or prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan expressly describes Kelly’s Garden as an inviting place to pray or spend time with friends; the activity requires no admission or purchase.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden across from the Rosary Circle with only two benches. The official page publishes no fixed access hours.

cards.title: Take In the Ohio Valley View
cards.subtitle: Reflection beneath Franciscan’s 60-foot cross
cards.notes: Walk up with a friend, read the dedication plaque, and take in the Ohio River view while staying within established campus paths.
cards.short_summary: A hilltop reflection stop connecting campus, the river valley, and local steel history.
cards.evidence_claim: The university invites visitors to stand and reflect at the 60-foot Steel Cross overlooking the Ohio River and Weirton; no purchase or admission is required.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor site at the campus edge beside Holy Spirit Friary. Stay on established approaches and avoid severe weather or icy conditions.

cards.title: Build a Downtown Mural Walk
cards.subtitle: Self-guided public art with free online audio
cards.notes: Open the official mural page, choose a compact cluster downtown, and play the available audio descriptions at each painted wall.
cards.short_summary: A flexible art walk through named murals documenting Steubenville’s people and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steubenville Visitor Center provides an official mural list, online audio descriptions, and maps for a self-guided outdoor tour with no admission or purchase.
cards.access_notes: Murals are spread across downtown exterior walls. Visit in daylight, remain on public sidewalks, and obtain a map at the Visitor Center if desired.

cards.title: Join Tuesday Praise and Worship
cards.subtitle: Student-led communal music and prayer in Finnegan Fieldhouse
cards.notes: Meet outside the fieldhouse before the session, enter together, and check Campus Evangelization for schedule changes before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A recurring student-led gathering centered on live worship music and communal prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s Office of Campus Evangelization invites people to its weekly student-led praise and worship gathering; no ticket, admission, or purchase is identified.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Tuesdays from 9–10 p.m. in Finnegan Fieldhouse. Confirm the current semester schedule before attending.
